about: Everything Kura downloads to a PC: the one list the installer shows and the engine follows. Kura downloads nothing that isn't here, and uses its own downloads only when their size and SHA-256 match. See docs/releasing.md.

downloads.name: Microsoft Edge WebView2
downloads.purpose: Draws Kura's window. Windows 11 has it; on a PC without it, the installer fetches Microsoft's installer for it.

downloads.name: ffmpeg
downloads.purpose: Reads what each video holds, and converts it. Kura fetches it the first time it starts.
